description: Scroll in a direction, or toward the top/bottom edge of scrollable content. Set until to a selector to reach an off-screen target in one command rather than a scroll-and-check loop. The optional amount is the finger-path fraction of the viewport axis, honored up to 0.8 of it; directional scrolls reduce release momentum, while app scroll physics determine the final content offset. A visible keyboard shortens the swiped band instead of being dismissed; when too little is left, the command refuses with scroll_keyboard_occludes_surface. A directional scroll also reports the movement it observed as movement: moved, at-edge, unchanged, or unobserved when the two reads could not back a claim either way; an unchanged surface inside a container that still hides content in that direction refuses with scroll_no_progress rather than repeating the requested distance. The movement field is absent where a tier verifies per pass (top/bottom, until), where the runtime cannot read a screen, where a settle observation or a replay already owns that observation, or where the operator opted out of it. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

device.description: Device name; ids go in udid or serial.

durationMs.description: Scroll duration in milliseconds when the backend supports pacing.

includeCost.description: Add agent cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) to the result, returned as JSON text.

maxPasses.description: Maximum scroll gestures for an until search (default 12). Requires until.

mcpOutputFormat.description: Result text: compact optimized (default) or the full result as JSON (larger).

responseLevel.description: Result detail: digest (smallest) or full (largest), as JSON; default is compact text.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

settleQuietMs.description: Settle: quiet window in milliseconds (default 500; 300 on the iOS simulator snapshot bridge). On iOS, a broad replacement of a non-empty screen holds at least 1500ms within timeoutMs.

until.description: Repeat scroll passes until this selector is visible on screen, then stop. Not valid with the top/bottom edge directions, which carry their own stop condition.

name: scroll
